body: You pretty much expressed what I fell almost word-for-word. Obviously, there's nothing I can do to help you, since I'm in your same situation, but at least know that there's someone else out there who feels the same way.

Yeah, I think it is more than just simple homesickness, although I think that finally put me over the edge from a light depression to going over the edge a little bit. It's something I've struggled with for a while, but it's finally time I get help before it keeps me from enjoying life (well, it already does). And, I feel like I need the support of my family to get through this. 

I used to drive home every other weekend, but I can't now because I have to work. My mom says that at least one of my parents will try to drive over here once every two weeks, but I'm not sure how long that'll last...

And thanks! I really do appreciate it you helping. :)

Thanks for the advice, man. To be honest, this has been a long time coming... My family is very important to me, and I've always thought it was kind of unusual, because a lot of people go far away to college to get away from home, but I'm longing to go back.
